title: sales.order.split
description: Splits an open order in two: the listed lines move to a brand-new order. `line_ids` absent or empty opens the second check blank. `label` is an opaque display string sales forwards without interpreting (ADR-0144); the link between the new order and the floor check is written by whoever owns that junction.

line_ids.description: Lines that move to the new order. Only unpaid lines of this very order travel; anything else is ignored.

label.description: Opaque display label for the new check ("Table 4 · 2").
